description: Correctness fixes + remaining backend mocks: sync+conflict mock (2E), ERP integration settings mock (2F), dashboard real KPIs/low-stock (3A), member level config + multi-tier auto-upgrade + CRM config screen (3B), and mobile Login/OTP/Forgot wired to authStore (3C). Independent of the other FEATs; builds on FEAT-001's flags module (2E/2F use MOCK_SYNC/MOCK_ERP).
steps: 2E: make src/store/syncStore.ts a coherent demonstrable mock under FEATURE_FLAGS.MOCK_SYNC — startSync/retry transitions queue -> syncing -> success with an occasional simulated conflict that routes to ConflictResolutionScreen; keep the existing setTimeout simulation but tidy it and ensure the queue persists via persistStorage (name 'pos-sync'). Touch SyncQueueScreen/SyncStatusScreen/ConflictResolutionScreen/SyncMonitorScreen only if needed for the demo. // MOCK: comment the simulated paths.

2F: add ERP mock. Create src/store/erpStore.ts (zustand+persist, name 'pos-erp') holding endpoint/credentials + last-sync result, OR extend storeConfigStore. Create src/screens/web/WebErpSettingsScreen.tsx (WebColors + tokens, Thai, loading/error/empty states) with endpoint/credential fields, a 'ทดสอบการเชื่อมต่อ' button that simulates success under MOCK_ERP, and a 'sync สินค้า/ยอดขาย' action reporting a simulated result. Replace the ERP SimpleSubPage placeholder in WebSimpleScreens.tsx (`if (subView === 'erp')`) with this screen.

3A: wire src/screens/dashboard/DashboardScreen.tsx and MainDashboardScreen.tsx to real stores — today's sales total + bill count from useSaleHistoryStore (getSalesToday(), completed only, grandTotal), member count from memberStore, low-stock list from useProductStore.products where stockQty <= minStock. Replace hardcoded KPI/LOW_STOCK arrays. Keep the card UI.

3B: in src/data/mockMembers.ts set MOCK_LEVEL_CONFIGS to manual values — silver minSpent 5000, gold 15000 (earnMultiplier 1.5), platinum 50000 (x2), vip 100000 (x3), with manual-consistent discountPercent. In src/screens/sale/PaymentScreen.tsx auto-upgrade: replace the single next-level check with 'pick the highest level config whose minSpent <= updatedMember.totalSpent' so a big jump can skip tiers. Add src/screens/web/WebCrmConfigScreen.tsx ('ตั้งค่า CRM > คะแนน/ระดับ') to edit pointConfig (earn/redeem/min/expire) and level thresholds, persisted via memberStore (add setters + persist pointConfig/level configs); register it in web settings or WebCRMScreen.

3C: wire mobile auth. In src/store/authStore.ts add requestOTP(phone) that stores a mock OTP in state, verifyOTP(phone, otp) that checks it, and resetPassword(username, newPassword) that updates registeredUsers. In src/navigation/AuthNavigator.tsx make Login onLogin call authStore.login() (throw/alert on failure instead of always onAuthSuccess), OTPLogin onRequestOTP/onVerifyOTP call the new store methods, and ForgotPassword onResetSuccess call resetPassword. Keep Thai UI.
acceptance_criteria: syncStore demonstrates queue->syncing->success with resolvable simulated conflicts, persisted, gated by MOCK_SYNC.
An ERP settings screen (reachable from web settings) tests connection and runs a mock product/sales sync with simulated results, persisted, gated by MOCK_ERP.
Dashboard KPIs and low-stock come from saleHistoryStore/memberStore/productStore, not hardcoded arrays; a new sale changes the numbers.
MOCK_LEVEL_CONFIGS matches the manual thresholds/multipliers and auto-upgrade can skip multiple tiers; a CRM config screen edits pointConfig/levels and persists.
Mobile Login rejects wrong credentials via authStore.login(); OTP login and Forgot-password reset work against the in-store mock.
verification: npm run lint (no new tsc errors beyond baseline 13)
findings: 2E: syncStore gated under FEATURE_FLAGS.MOCK_SYNC — startSync now does queue->syncing->success with ~20% simulated conflict (routes to ConflictResolution), retry/retryAll likewise; MOCK_SYNC=off = deterministic success. Persists via 'pos-sync'. All simulated paths tagged // MOCK:. 2F: added src/store/erpStore.ts (persist 'pos-erp'; testConnection/runSync gated by MOCK_ERP with commented real-service else) + src/screens/web/WebErpSettingsScreen.tsx (WebColors+tokens, Thai, loading via ActivityIndicator, error via lastError, empty state before connect). Replaced ERP SimpleSubPage in WebSimpleScreens. 3A: DashboardScreen + MainDashboardScreen now derive today's sales/bill count from useSaleHistoryStore.getSalesToday() (completed only, grandTotal), member count from memberStore, low-stock from productStore (stockQty<=minStock), top products aggregated from completed sales; added empty states; week/month on MainDashboard kept as mock historical (no real aggregation exists). 3B: MOCK_LEVEL_CONFIGS set to manual thresholds (silver 5000, gold 15000 x1.5, platinum 50000 x2, vip 100000 x3) with consistent minBills/discount; PaymentScreen auto-upgrade now picks highest config whose minSpent<=totalSpent (multi-tier skip) with up-only guard; added memberStore levelConfigs + setPointConfig/setLevelConfigs/updateLevelConfig (persisted via 'pos-members'); new src/screens/web/WebCrmConfigScreen.tsx edits pointConfig + level configs, registered as 'crmConfig' card in web settings. 3C: authStore gained pendingOTPs + requestOTP/verifyOTP/resetPassword (// MOCK: tagged); AuthNavigator Login now calls authStore.login() and throws on failure, OTPLogin wired to requestOTP (alerts mock code)/verifyOTP, ForgotPassword wired to resetPassword via new onReset prop. Verification: npm run lint = 13 baseline tsc errors (no new); npx tsx engine.test.ts Failed:0 (39 passed); npm test = 14 passed with only the 3 known pre-existing suite-load failures. No new vitest suite added because store files import react-native (Platform/persistStorage) which hits the documented baseline RN resolution failure under vitest; logic is store-level, not engine/adapter.
